introduction: WOOKTOOL auto-lock tape measures are designed for buyers who want controlled blade extension and a one-button rewind experience for hardware, DIY and retail programs. The page helps buyers compare functional requirements before selecting a model for sampling.

For branded projects, the factory can review logo treatment, shell color, blade unit, hook configuration, lanyard, belt clip, retail artwork, barcode and carton mark. Final options depend on the selected tape measure structure and order quantity.
To receive a faster quote, provide the length, scale requirement, target market, expected quantity and packaging direction together with any logo artwork or reference images.

faq.question: What is an auto-lock tape measure?
faq.answer: An auto-lock tape measure holds the blade after extension until the release control is pressed, helping users read a measurement without continuously holding the blade.

faq.question: Can I choose metric, imperial or dual-scale printing?
faq.answer: Yes. The scale direction should be confirmed with the selected model and destination market during RFQ review.

faq.question: Is a magnetic hook available?
faq.answer: Magnetic hook configuration can be reviewed for suitable models; confirm the required hook type and intended application in the inquiry.

faq.question: What should be tested before bulk production?
faq.answer: Confirm the auto-lock release, rewind function, blade readability, hook alignment, case assembly, logo appearance and packaging before bulk approval.

faq.question: Can this model be supplied with custom packaging?
faq.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss blister cards, color boxes, display packaging, barcode labels and export carton marks.
